tokens.name: crust
tokens.usage: Deepest surface. Player stage behind video, drop zones, and the text colour on accent fills in Mocha (`primary-foreground`). In Latte it is a light chrome tint, never a text colour.

tokens.name: mantle
tokens.usage: Chrome surface: sidebar, title bar, popovers, dialogs. Text on it: `text` (12.14:1 Mocha, 6.57:1 Latte) or `subtext1` (9.91 / 5.14).

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: App background and the main content ground. `text` 11.34:1 in Mocha, 7.06:1 in Latte; `subtext1` 9.26 / 5.53.

tokens.name: surface0
tokens.usage: Cards, hover rows, hairline dividers. Put `text` on it (8.69:1 Mocha, 5.17:1 Latte); `subtext1` drops to 4.05:1 in Latte, so secondary text on cards uses `text`.

tokens.name: surface1
tokens.usage: Input fill, pressed rows, track of progress bars. `text` on it is 6.31:1 in Mocha but 4.39:1 in Latte: keep text on `input` short and in `text`, never in `subtext`.

tokens.name: surface2
tokens.usage: Strong dividers, unselected toggles, relief blocks. Decorative: not a text ground.

tokens.name: overlay0
tokens.usage: Disabled and placeholder marks. Mocha 3.36:1 on base; Latte only 2.30:1, so in Latte it is decorative and never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: overlay1
tokens.usage: Quiet icons and secondary glyphs in Mocha (4.44:1 on base). Latte 2.83:1: decorative only.

tokens.name: overlay2
tokens.usage: Buffered ranges and quiet icons. Mocha 5.81:1 on base; Latte 3.49:1 (passes 3:1 for marks, not for text).

tokens.name: subtext0
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and captions on `background` and `sidebar` in Mocha (7.37:1). In Latte it misses 4.5:1 on base (4.37:1): the source pair is kept exact; `muted-foreground` switches to `subtext1` in Latte for that reason.

tokens.name: subtext1
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`: 9.26:1 Mocha, 5.53:1 Latte on base. On `card` in Latte it is 4.05:1: use `text` there.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`, `card`: at least 8.69:1 in Mocha and 5.17:1 in Latte.

tokens.name: rosewater
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Decorative fill or tag colour. Not text in Latte (2.34:1 on base).

tokens.name: flamingo
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Decorative fill or tag colour. Not text in Latte (2.64:1 on base).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Optional accent and cover-tint colour. Not text in Latte (2.34:1 on base).

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: The default accent (`primary` aliases it). Mocha 8.07:1 on base, Latte 4.79:1; works as text and as a mark on `background`, `sidebar`, `card`.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (`destructive` aliases it). Mocha 7.08:1, Latte 4.80:1 on base: allowed as text on `background` and `sidebar`. Status role: destructive.

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Decorative; Latte 3.48:1 on base (marks only, not text).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warnings (use `ctp-peach` for warnings, `warning-text` for its text). Mocha 9.27:1; Latte 2.64:1 on base, so always pair with an icon and a word set in `text`. Status role: warning.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Ratings, highlights, 'new' dots. Mocha 12.91:1; Latte 2.31:1, so never the only carrier of meaning and never text in Latte.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success and completed states (use `ctp-green` for success). Mocha 11.03:1; Latte 2.96:1, just under 3:1 for marks: pair with an icon and a word set in `text`. Status role: success.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Optional accent; downloaded/offline marker. Latte 3.31:1 on base (marks only).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Optional accent. Latte 2.47:1 on base (decorative).

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Info and queued states (use `ctp-blue` for info; sapphire is the older choice). Mocha 8.69:1; Latte 2.78:1: pair with an icon and a word set in `text`.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Links and optional accent. Mocha 7.79:1; Latte 4.34:1 on base (just under 4.5:1 as text). Status role: info (`ctp-blue`).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Optional accent and secondary highlight. Mocha 9.17:1; Latte 2.81:1 on base (decorative).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen. Text on it: `foreground`, `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icon colour on `background`, `sidebar`, `popover`, `card`.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar, title bar and bars outside the player.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels and tiles. Lists and settings groups use it at 40% (`bg-card/40`) with a `border`; interactive rows go to `card/70` and `border-input` on hover.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, command palette, toasts.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The user-chosen accent (one of the 14 Catppuccin colours, `data-accent`; Mauve by default). Fills primary buttons, switches, progress fills, the active-nav bar (`border-primary`) and, at 15%, active rows and primary badges. Not for text: use `primary-text`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `primary` fill. Crust on the dark flavors. On Latte it is base for mauve (4.79:1), red (4.80:1) and blue (4.34:1, just under AA, accepted), and `#11111b` for the other 11 pastel accents (rosewater, flamingo, pink, maroon, peach, yellow, green, teal, sky, sapphire, lavender; 4.77 to 7.17:1); the override lives in `styles.css`.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons on `background`, `sidebar`, `card/40` and the `primary/15` tint. On Latte the accent is mixed 55% with the Mocha crust: all 14 accents are then 4.79:1 or better (rosewater 4.85, flamingo 5.14, pink 4.82, mauve 6.65, red 6.41, maroon 5.74, peach 5.02, yellow 4.79, green 5.42, teal 5.72, sky 4.91, sapphire 5.26, blue 6.42, lavender 5.33). Plain `primary` as text is only 2.3 to 3.5:1 on pastel Latte accents.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons (with `border-input`; hover goes to surface1).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: count chips, skeletons, empty-state tiles.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (metadata, hints, helper copy). 7.37:1 in Mocha on base. Matane uses subtext0 everywhere; here Latte takes subtext1 because subtext0 is 4.37:1 on base. On `card` solid it can drop below 4.5:1 in Latte: prefer `card/40` grounds.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted-row background (menu items, ghost buttons, sidebar hover). Not the brand accent (that is `primary`). It equals `card`, `muted` and `secondary`, so hover is invisible on those solid fills.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: outline buttons (`border-destructive/40 text-destructive`), error boxes (`border/40 bg/10` tint, text `danger-text`), failed rows. 7.08:1 in Mocha, 4.80:1 on Latte base.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `destructive` fill (window close button hover, exclude marks). Its own variable (`--app-on-destructive`) so Latte keeps 4.80:1 when the accent override changes `primary-foreground`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Outline of fields, checkboxes, switches and secondary buttons (`border-input`); also the fill of progress tracks and counts.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring (`:focus-visible`, solid 2px, offset 2px). Follows `primary`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Fixed near-black for marks drawn on a raw palette colour regardless of flavor (the check on the accent swatches in Settings).

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text (`text-success-text`) on `background`, `sidebar`, `card`, and the `ctp-green/10` tint. Latte plain green is 2.7:1 on its tint; the mix gives 5.14 to 7.01:1 across those grounds. Icons, borders and fills keep `ctp-green`.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text (`text-warning-text`). Latte plain peach is 2.4:1 on its tint; the mix gives 4.79 to 6.54:1. Icons, borders and fills keep `ctp-peach`.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Info text (`text-info-text`). Latte plain blue is 3.8:1 on its tint; the mix gives 5.48 to 7.48:1. Icons, borders and fills keep `ctp-blue`.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive text (`text-danger-text`) in boxes, alerts and the destructive button label. Latte plain red is 4.06:1 on its tint; the mix gives 5.07 to 6.92:1. Borders and solid fills keep `destructive`.

tokens.name: ctp-green
tokens.usage: Status colour for success icons, borders and fills (`border-ctp-green/40 bg-ctp-green/10`); the text is `success-text`. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: ctp-peach
tokens.usage: Warning icons, borders and fills; the text is `warning-text`.

tokens.name: ctp-blue
tokens.usage: Info icons, borders and fills (sapphire in the Phase 0-4 UI); the text is `info-text`.

tokens.name: video-stage
tokens.usage: Stage behind the video and the letterbox, identical in both themes. Never light.

tokens.name: video-scrim
tokens.usage: Translucent top and bottom player bars (85% crust) over the picture, identical in both themes. Text and icons on it use `video-text`; the bars carry a 1px `video-track` hairline.

tokens.name: video-text
tokens.usage: Time, titles and icons in the player chrome (12.97:1 on `video-stage`).

tokens.name: video-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the player chrome, such as episode name and quality (8.42:1 on `video-stage`).

tokens.name: video-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled seek and volume track. The `video-buffered` fill is 3.23:1 against it.

tokens.name: video-buffered
tokens.usage: Buffered range on the seek bar, drawn between `video-track` and `video-accent`.

tokens.name: video-accent
tokens.usage: Played range, thumb, active control and focus ring inside the player, 9.23:1 on `video-stage`.

tokens.name: video-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `video-accent` fills in the player (9.23:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles (`text-xl font-semibold`) and onboarding headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, empty and error state titles (`text-base font-semibold`).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section and settings-card headings, episode names (`text-sm font-semibold`).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up on the same episode next time.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges and count chips (`text-[11px]`), kbd hints.

styles.name: mono-time
styles.usage: Playback time and duration in the player, always in tabular figures.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: File sizes, speeds, ETA, segment counts in Downloads.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between a title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between grid cells.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Toolbar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large gaps in empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and onboarding spacing.

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Custom title bar height (drag region, back/forward, search, status, window controls).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: sidebar-w-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar width.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Player top bar height.

tokens.name: bottombar-h
tokens.usage: Player bottom bar height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small items: menu rows, pills inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search field, covers' inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers, cover tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, round icon buttons, progress tracks, count pills.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers floating over content.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and the command palette.
